sources.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`). ... | Ability rotation casts (`_schedule_shared_casts`, `_compute_ability_rotation`) | shared-timeline renewal schedule; cast starts within window | EXACT |
sources.reading: The rotation contract admits any cast whose resource/cooldown state permits it at that instant; a stocked second charge is available at t=0, so nothing in the scheduling identity forbids Q2 as the second cast.

independent_computation.question: At the scenario's splinter value, what is the second entry of Syndra's cast order?
independent_computation.step_1_identify_the_scenario_knob: The scenario suffix '120' matches exactly one Syndra quantity in the cached data: Splinters of Wrath, which cap at 120 (S2) and whose capstone (+15% AP) fires at 120 (S3). The module's splinters option range is documented as 0-120 (S7, S8). Therefore syndra_custom_order_120 = Syndra at 120 splinters, i.e. every Transcendent threshold satisfied.
independent_computation.step_2_threshold_arithmetic: Splinter thresholds read off the cached wiki text: Q second charge >= 40 (S1), W true damage >= 60 (S10), E scatter/slow >= 80, R execute >= 100, P +15% AP = 120 (S3). Scenario value 120 >= 40, so the Q charge cap is 2, not 1.
independent_computation.step_3_charge_semantics: Dark Sphere at >= 40 splinters is an ammo/stocked-cast resource (S4, S6): the 7 s figure is the per-charge recharge and R's passive (S5) only shortens that recharge. Two stocked charges are on hand at t=0, so two Dark Sphere casts are legal back-to-back with no cooldown wait between them. In the one-hands/shared-timeline scheduling contract (S9) the only cost of the second cast is its own cast time (Dark Sphere castTime = 'none' in the cache), so nothing displaces it from index 1.
independent_computation.step_4_label_resolution: 'Q2' is this codebase's synthetic slot name for exactly that second stocked charge (S7: "synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)", ammo atom "Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters"; S8: "40+ Q charges via Q2 slot"). So the sequence Q, Q2, W, ... is 'spend both stocked Dark Spheres, then Force of Will'.
independent_computation.step_5_conclusion: cast_order = [Q, Q2, W, ...]; cast_order[1] = Q2. The old value W is the sequence that never spends the second stocked charge in the leading position — i.e. a rotation computed as if the charge cap were 1, which is only true below 40 splinters and is contradicted by the scenario's own 120 value.
independent_computation.materiality_check: Dropping/deferring the second Dark Sphere is not cosmetic. Q rank 5 = 230 (+70% AP) (S1 leveling row). At 120 splinters the +15% AP capstone applies (S3), so with a nominal 500 AP loadout: AP_eff = 500 x 1.15 = 575; Q_raw = 230 + 0.70 x 575 = 632.5; against 100 MR the mitigation identity m(R) = 100/(100+R) = 0.5 (docs/math-foundations.md Section 2.1) gives 316.25 post-mitigation per Dark Sphere. Illustrative stats (the scenario's own AP/MR are outside this evidence tree), but it fixes the order of magnitude: whether the second charge is in the rotation is a several-hundred-damage leaf, not a naming detail.
independent_computation.counter_hypothesis_tested: Could W legitimately hold index 1 — i.e. is there a game rule that forces Force of Will before the second sphere? No. W grabs 'the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster' (S10), so it is not gated on a second sphere existing, and its own Transcendent bonus is a 60-splinter damage rider, not an ordering constraint. The one sphere created by the first Q already satisfies any grab-a-sphere reading. Conversely, no cached rule permits only one Dark Sphere cast at 120 splinters — S1 is explicit that the cap is 2. So the old value is unsupported and the new value is required.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition itself (its explicit stat block and any user-supplied cast order) lives outside the permitted evidence tree, so the splinters=120 reading of the '120' suffix is inferred from the cached data (S2/S3/S7/S8) rather than read from the scenario file. Under that reading the verdict is unambiguous. The only world in which 'W' would be right is one where the scenario pins splinters < 40, which would contradict its own name and the documented 0-120 option range.
verdict_statement: new_value_correct - at 120 Splinters of Wrath Syndra stocks 2 Dark Sphere charges (wiki threshold 40), both are spendable at fight start, and 'Q2' is precisely the second-charge slot; the second cast is Q2, not W.
